sources.title: Sakana Fugu: One Model to Command Them All
sources.evidence: June 22, 2026 announcement explicitly makes Fugu and Fugu Ultra generally available through a commercial API. Fugu is the latency-focused variant with configurable worker exclusions. The post links the technical report.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu Technical Report, v2, sections 3.1 and4
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. Section 3.1 names an unspecified pretrained LM backbone, a lightweight worker-selection head and singular-value-scale adaptation; neither nominal backbone/complete-model size nor active count is given. Fugu scales and adapts the Trinity method, removes its role-assignment outputs and adds supervised routing training. The small trainable subset is not an active-inference parameter count. Section 4/Table 1 compares benchmark scores without a total or active parameter column.

sources.title: Toward backbone-independent orchestration: validation of Gemma 4-based Sakana Fugu
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. August 10 update says previous orchestrators were trained from Qwen, without version or size. Its comparable-scale Gemma 4 E2B validation is explicitly a separate backbone experiment trained similarly to Fugu; it does not identify a counted Qwen checkpoint or say the bare fugu endpoint deployed Gemma 4 E2B. Hundreds-of-billions-class models describe the worker pool, not the orchestrator.

sources.title: Pinned official Fugu integration model catalog
sources.evidence: Exact slug fugu has display_name Fugu, context_window 1000000, text/image input, high/xhigh reasoning levels and parallel tool-call support. This is an API integration contract, not a neural checkpoint configuration. Its no-reasoning-summaries flag is distinct from reasoning support. Fresh October 27 read confirms this exact-slug entry contains no nominal total, active count or named neural backbone.

sources.title: Sakana API models and supported endpoints
sources.evidence: Bare fugu is the default variant and routes to an appropriate worker. Documents reasoning effort controls, function tools/tool_choice, text formats, and a fugu web_search example. Ultra versions and Max are separate identifiers. Current underlying pool membership is not fully disclosed. Fresh October 27 read found performance, pricing and API-argument tables, but no total or active learned-parameter count for bare fugu.

sources.title: Sakana AI API Platform Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms effective September 28, 2026 cover Fugu API use. Service and configuration IP remains with Sakana and relevant licensors; permission is limited to service use and does not grant model redistribution rights. This supports proprietary hosted access, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu beta announcement
sources.evidence: April 24, 2026 announces beta applications and describes Fugu Mini and Fugu Ultra variants. It does not explicitly establish identity between that Mini revision and the later bare fugu offering. Earlier family beta is distinguished from the exact-name June 22 general release.

sources.title: Official Fugu repository file inventory
sources.evidence: Complete repository tree contains integration scripts/configuration, demos and a technical report; no checkpoint tensor files. Also checked SakanaAI HuggingFace fugu search, which returned no models. No published exact orchestrator weights or neural configuration were located.

sources.title: Initial official integration catalog, June 17, 2026 commit
sources.evidence: June 17 initial deployment commit already configures bare fugu and 1M context. A client configuration commit is not evidence that public API access began that date. No June 15 release claim occurs here.

sources.title: Introducing Fugu Max and Fugu Ultra v2
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. September 11 announcement introduces separate Max and Ultra v2 variants with the same core orchestration architecture and modular worker pools; it names no counted base for bare Fugu. Its multi-trillion-parameter sentence is a generic inefficiency example, not a Fugu specification. Later comparison charts report benchmark scores and token prices, not total or active parameters.

sources.title: Sakana Fugu Technical Report submission history
sources.evidence: Version 1 was submitted June 19, 2026 and version 2 June 23. Both full HTML versions were checked for an explicit Mini-to-Fugu rename or exact revision mapping; none was found. These are paper dates, not independently verified API availability dates.

sources.title: Trinity: An Evolved LLM Coordinator, original report v2, abstract and Table 6
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 original-source follow-up to secondary 0.6B Fugu claims. Trinity identifies an approximately 0.6B Qwen3-0.6B coordinator and approximately 10K head; Table 6 reports 9,216 singular-value and 10,240 linear-head trainable parameters. This is the named Trinity research model, predating Fugu. The later Fugu paper explicitly changes the method and head outputs without identifying an unchanged Qwen3-0.6B backbone. Trinity counts therefore do not establish bare Fugu total or active parameters.

sources.title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision, original report, section 4.1 and comparison results
sources.publisher: Sakana AI and UC Berkeley / arXiv
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27, 2026 as a later original research comparison/lineage check, alongside the official MASS announcement and detailed research blog. Section 4.1 identifies Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 as the MASS experiment base; reported comparisons concern its shared-model training generations. Fugu is cited for orchestration background, not identified as this 27B model. No explicit active-parameter column or counted bare-Fugu comparison was found. MASS does not supply a size or unchanged-base relationship for Fugu.

name.note: Exact bare fugu offering, distinct from Ultra and Max.

developer.note: Sakana develops the learned routing system; workers can be provided by other developers.

family.note: Normalized name for the Fugu product family.

release_date.note: Explicit general release of the bare-name Fugu variant. Earlier April 24 beta is described as Fugu Mini, whose exact identity continuity is unconfirmed. June 17 configuration and June 19 paper submission are not service-launch evidence. Baseline June 15 is unsupported; the dated Ultra sibling ID cannot establish this date.

open_weights.note: Commercial API offering; public integration code and demos do not distribute its learned orchestrator weights. Open workers do not make the combined service open-weight.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted Fugu service. Neither a worker license nor the research paper copyright licenses this complete system.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no published nominal total or identified counted base for bare Fugu. The original report leaves its LM backbone unnamed; the later Qwen-family statement lacks a checkpoint/size. Trinity Qwen3-0.6B, separate Gemma 4 E2B validation and MASS Qwen3.6-27B research do not establish unchanged deployed-model lineage. Generic worker-pool scale and the successor post's multi-trillion example are not Fugu counts.

active_parameters_b.note: Checked active counts separately in the original report, later Sakana research/release comparisons and a fresh bounded search for Fugu active/activated-parameter tables. No nominal active count for this exact model was found. A single selected worker, a small trainable head/subset and named experimental backbone sizes do not specify inference-active learned parameters; no pool sum or total-equals-active inference is used.

architecture.note: Learned LM-based routing and historical Qwen lineage are documented, but the exact deployed backbone neural topology is undisclosed. A pool of independently called models is not a neural MoE checkpoint.

context_window.note: Official exact-slug client catalog advertises 1,000,000 tokens. This is the Fugu service interface allowance, not proof that its router or every selectable worker natively has that context.

modalities.note: Text/image API input and text output contract. This describes the composed service, without asserting a native vision encoder in the orchestrator.

reasoning.note: Fugu exposes high/xhigh reasoning controls; max aliases xhigh. Capability belongs to the routed service, not evidence that the selection head emits a reasoning trace. Reasoning summaries are disabled in the integration catalog.

tool_call.note: API supports model-selected function tools and tool_choice, plus documented built-in web_search; official fugu config supports parallel tool calls.

description.value: Learned router that selects a worker model for each input, exposed through a text-and-image API.
description.note: Uses the exact variant's single-worker routing description rather than applying Ultra's deeper coordination mechanism.

patch.notes: June 22, 2026 is the documented general release of bare Fugu; the April 24 beta used the Fugu Mini name, whose revision continuity is unconfirmed. Fugu is a learned router that selects one worker per input. Its earlier backbone is identified only as Qwen-based; Trinity's 0.6B coordinator and the separate Gemma 4 E2B validation do not establish Fugu's deployed size. Total and active parameter counts and exact neural topology remain undisclosed. The 1M context, text/image input, reasoning and tool support describe the hosted service interface.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains undisclosed total and active counts, with explicit null patch values and parameters_source. Reopened the original Fugu report, release, exact integration config, API model documentation, August Gemma 4 validation and September successor release; followed secondary 0.6B claims to original Trinity and checked October MASS research/comparisons. Neither an exact counted base relationship nor a nominal active-count convention for bare Fugu was established. Preserves the other 12 field assessments, including June 22 general availability and service-interface capabilities; current authenticated operation remains untested.
